walkthroughs.body_html:
Individual Research Project — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Individual Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Individual Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: avoir
être
aller
faire
nuclear family
extended family
blended family
single-parent family

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I was using my computer when the phone rang' in French?
options: J'ai utilisé mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
J'utilisais mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
Lui sœur / elle sœur.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'his sister' and 'her sister' in French?
options: Both are 'sa sœur' - possessives agree with the OBJECT possessed, not the owner.
Lui sœur / elle sœur.
A noun.
His = son, her = sa - based on owner's gender.
A noun.
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
An infinitive.
A verb in the subjunctive mood.
